description: A React component implementing the login page for Mattermost, handling user authentication, external OAuth logins, session management, and UI rendering.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: React component for the Mattermost login page, managing user login, external OAuth options, session expiration, and UI rendering.

methods.name: getExternalLoginOptions
methods.description: Generates external OAuth login options based on configuration.

methods.name: handleExternalAuth
methods.description: Handles external OAuth login button clicks, managing desktop app and embedded view behaviors.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Dismisses alert banners.

methods.name: onDismissSessionExpired
methods.description: Handles session expiration dismissal, resets relevant states.

methods.name: configureTitle
methods.description: Sets the document title based on session state.

methods.name: showSessionExpiredNotificationIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays notification when session has expired.

methods.name: getAlertData
methods.description: Prepares alert banner data based on current state and URL parameters.

methods.name: getAlternateLink
methods.description: Returns the alternate link component for sign-up or access problem pages.

methods.name: preSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validating inputs and initiating login process.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Performs login dispatch and handles login errors.

methods.name: checkUserLoginType
methods.description: Checks if user login is via magic link or deactivated.

methods.name: postSubmit
methods.description: Finalizes login, loads user data, and redirects appropriately.

methods.name: finishSignin
methods.description: Redirects user after successful login based on team or onboarding state.

methods.name: handleHeaderBackButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles back button click in MFA view.

methods.name: handleInputOnChange
methods.description: Handles changes to login ID input.

methods.name: handlePasswordInputOnChange
methods.description: Handles changes to password input.

methods.name: handleBrandImageError
methods.description: Handles error loading brand image.

methods.name: getCardTitle
methods.description: Returns the login card title based on configuration.

methods.name: getMessageSubtitle
methods.description: Returns the subtitle message for the login page.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLink
methods.description: Returns the reset password link component if applicable.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Renders the main content of the login page, including MFA, login form, and external login options.
